group.title: An electronics factory tour
group.passage: Welcome to Northfield Electronics. Before we begin the factory tour, please place your phones and cameras in the lockers beside reception. Photography is not permitted in the production areas because customer designs are visible there. We will first visit the surface-mount line, then observe final inspection through the viewing windows. We cannot enter the cleanroom today while a new filter system is being tested. Your visitor badges must remain visible throughout the tour. Afterward, we will return to reception for questions, and refreshments will be served in the meeting room across the hall.
group.passageZh: 歡迎來到 Northfield Electronics。開始工廠導覽前，請把手機和相機放入接待櫃檯旁的置物櫃。由於產區內看得到客戶設計，生產區禁止拍照。我們會先參觀表面黏著產線，再透過觀景窗觀看最終檢驗。今天新的過濾系統正在測試，因此不能進入無塵室。整趟導覽期間，請讓訪客識別證保持可見。結束後我們會回到接待處接受提問，點心則在走廊對面的會議室供應。
